name: iter_lr_normal
description: LEARNING-RATE PERSPECTIVE, standard setting: five per-round learning-rate schedules (constant, exponential, cosine anneal, SGDR warm restarts, inverse-time) crossed with the three mix policies. A decaying rate limits how far each later round can move the weights, which is a second, optimiser-side route to the same focus-vs-coverage trade the mix controls from the data side. K=8, 15 seeds.
